keySentence: The beanstalk grew so tall Jack felt dizzy.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Jack climbed very high. He saw a castle. He felt dizzy. The beanstalk grew so tall Jack felt dizzy.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Jack climbed through the clouds and saw an amazing sight. There was a huge castle sitting on top of the clouds. The beanstalk grew so tall Jack felt dizzy looking down. His legs were shaking but he stepped onto the cloud. The castle was bigger than anything he had ever seen. Jack took a deep breath and walked toward the giant door.
